verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents its own Marketing Emails API for programmatically creating, updating and retrieving marketing emails, which is a thin API-managed path toward managing email content as code. The evidence does not show templates as code, HTML/MJML authoring, variable substitution or version-control integration. Template mentions refer only to the drag-and-drop editor UI. Missing for 10: HTML/MJML template-as-code workflow, API-managed templates (as opposed to individual emails), variable/merge-tag substitution, version-control or CLI sync, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage email templates as code — HTML/MJML or API-managed templates with variable substitution — under version control

citations.quote: You can use the Marketing Emails API to programmatically create, update, and get details about marketing emails.
To retrieve an individual email, make a `GET` request to `/marketing/v3/emails/{emailId}`
